datasets.name: ODSConstPolicy
datasets.sql:
select icp.rowid, icp.* from ins_constructionpolicy icp
where icp.cs_id= :cs_id

datasets.name: ODSCONSTSUGGEST
datasets.sql:
SELECT  S.ROWID,S.* FROM INS_CONSTRUCTIONSUGGEST S 
WHERE CID=:CID

datasets.name: ODSConstruction
datasets.sql: select c.rowid,c.*from ins_construction c where c.id=:id

datasets.name: Customers
datasets.sql: select c.rowid,c.id,c.name||' '||c.surname||' '||c.fathername as name,c.address,c.mobilephone,c.fax,c.contactperson,c.contactpersonphone from ins_customers c

datasets.name: ODSRisks
datasets.sql: select idr.rowid, idr.* from ins_dict_risks idr

datasets.name: Franshiz
datasets.sql: select idr.rowid, idr.* from ins_dict_franshiz idr

datasets.name: Conditions
datasets.sql: select idr.rowid, idr.* from ins_dict_conditions idr

datasets.name: ODSConstructionR
datasets.sql: select PINS_FullMotor.returnName(kli_id) as name,Pins_FullMotor.returnAddress(kli_id) as Address,Pins_FullMotor.returnPhone(kli_id) as phone,pins_fullmotor.returnFax(kli_id) as fax,c.*from ins_construction c where c.id=:id

datasets.name: ODSAgent
datasets.sql: select ia.rowid,ia.id,ia.name||' '||ia.surname||' '||ia.fathername as name from ins_agents ia

datasets.name: ODSContracts
datasets.sql:
select ic.rowid, ic.* from ins_contracts ic
where blank_id = :blankid
and type_id = 10

datasets.name: AValute
datasets.sql: select valute, val_name, valu_name, valu_short from avalute
